News agency apologises to Karnataka minister for misreporting remarks

The Press Trust of India (PTI) has issued an apology to Karnataka Minister Priyank Kharge. The apology is for misreporting his remarks concerning the police constable recruitment exam. Both The News Minute and Newslaundry reported on the apology.
